parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module is a single HTTP adapter. OrderController and ProductController map routes to application use cases through constructor injection and expose the same routes(): Router shape. requestParsers.ts holds all request-body and query validation and converts input into application DTOs. errorHandler.ts is the only place that maps errors to HTTP statuses (statusFor). Neither controller validates input or formats errors inline, so the module's own abstractions are not bypassed. ADVANCE_ACTIONS only maps URL segments to target states; transition rules stay in AdvanceOrderUseCase and the domain. Possible duplication (minor): parsePlaceOrderCommand rejects an empty lines array, and the domain has EmptyOrderError for the same case. This is treated as a request-shape check, not a duplicated domain invariant. The parser only checks that quantity is a number and leaves quantity validity to the domain (InvalidQuantityError), which suggests the split is deliberate. No unrelated concerns and no duplicated rule inside the module.
